product_overview: Jawak is a bid-based marketplace backend for custom clothing manufacturing in Pakistan. Clients post apparel requests, vendors bid and fulfill orders, and admins handle disputes and analytics across the full request-to-review lifecycle.
core_goals: Enable Google OAuth sign-in and JWT-based API access for clients, vendors, and admins
Allow clients to create and manage custom apparel design requests with reference images
Support vendor profiles, portfolios, and job discovery for manufacturing businesses
Provide bid submission, bid acceptance, and automatic order creation workflows
Track production milestones, delivery confirmation, and post-completion reviews
Deliver notifications, messaging, dispute resolution, and admin analytics for marketplace operations

features.name: Authentication (Google OAuth to JWT)
features.description: Users sign in with Google OAuth and receive internal JWT access and refresh tokens for authenticated API access.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/user/auth/google/ with valid Google access_token -> Receive 200 with access, refresh, and user -> GET /api/v1/user/me/ with Bearer access token -> Receive 200 with current user profile
POST /api/v1/user/auth/token/refresh/ with valid refresh token -> Receive 200 with new access token -> POST /api/v1/user/auth/token/verify/ with new access token -> Receive 200 OK
POST /api/v1/user/auth/google/ with missing or invalid Google token -> Receive 400 Invalid or missing Google token
POST /api/v1/user/me/ without Bearer token -> Receive 401 Unauthorized

features.name: Vendor Profiles
features.description: Vendors can create and manage manufacturer profiles, maintain portfolios, and browse vendor listings.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/user/auth/google/ with valid Google token -> Receive JWTs -> PUT /api/v1/vendors/me/ with company_name, location, specialties, and capacity -> Receive 200 VendorProfile -> GET /api/v1/vendors/me/ with Bearer token -> Receive 200 own vendor profile
POST /api/v1/vendors/me/portfolio/ with multipart image, title, and description -> Receive 201 PortfolioItem -> GET /api/v1/vendors/me/portfolio/ -> Receive 200 list of portfolio items
GET /api/v1/vendors/ with Bearer token -> Receive 200 VendorProfile[] list
GET /api/v1/vendors/{vendor_id}/ for a non-existent vendor id -> Receive 404 Not found
PUT /api/v1/vendors/me/ with invalid profile data -> Receive 400 Validation error

features.name: Design Requests
features.description: Clients create custom apparel jobs with specifications, upload reference images, and manage request lifecycle actions.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/requests/ with title, description, apparel_type, quantity, material, sizes, color_preferences, deadline, and design details -> Receive 201 DesignRequest -> POST /api/v1/requests/{request_id}/reference-images/ with multipart image and label -> Receive 201 DesignReferenceImage -> GET /api/v1/requests/{request_id}/ -> Receive 200 request with nested reference images
GET /api/v1/requests/ as a client -> Receive 200 list scoped to the client's own requests
GET /api/v1/requests/ as a vendor -> Receive 200 list of open marketplace requests
PATCH /api/v1/requests/{request_id}/ by a non-owner -> Receive 403 Not owner
POST /api/v1/requests/ with invalid or incomplete request payload -> Receive 400 Validation error
DELETE /api/v1/requests/{request_id}/reference-images/{image_id}/ for a missing image -> Receive 404 Not found

features.name: Bids
features.description: Vendors place proposals on design requests, and request owners can accept, reject, or vendors can withdraw pending bids.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/requests/{request_id}/ -> Receive 200 design request details -> GET /api/v1/bids/?request={request_id} -> Receive 200 Bid[] for the request -> POST /api/v1/bids/ with design_request, proposed_price, delivery_days, and message -> Receive 201 Bid
GET /api/v1/bids/ as a vendor without request filter -> Receive 200 list of the vendor's own bids
PATCH /api/v1/bids/{bid_id}/status/ with status=accepted by the request owner -> Receive 200 Bid -> Create Order automatically -> GET /api/v1/orders/ -> Receive 200 list including new order
POST /api/v1/bids/{bid_id}/withdraw/ for a pending bid -> Receive 200 Bid with withdrawn status
POST /api/v1/bids/ with duplicate vendor/request combination or invalid values -> Receive 400 Validation error (duplicate/invalid)
PATCH /api/v1/bids/{bid_id}/status/ with an invalid transition -> Receive 400 Invalid transition
POST /api/v1/bids/{bid_id}/withdraw/ after bid is no longer pending -> Receive 400 Cannot withdraw

features.name: Orders
features.description: Accepted bids become tracked orders with forward-only production stages and delivery confirmation.
user_flows: PATCH /api/v1/bids/{bid_id}/status/ with status=accepted -> Receive 200 Bid -> Order is created automatically -> GET /api/v1/orders/{order_id}/ -> Receive 200 Order with production timeline

POST /api/v1/orders/{order_id}/production-updates/ with stage, note, and optional image by the assigned vendor -> Receive 201 ProductionUpdate -> GET /api/v1/orders/{order_id}/ -> Receive 200 updated current_stage and timeline
POST /api/v1/orders/{order_id}/confirm-delivery/ by the client after delivery -> Receive 200 Order -> Order status becomes completed
POST /api/v1/orders/{order_id}/production-updates/ with a backward or invalid stage transition -> Receive 400 Invalid stage transition
POST /api/v1/orders/{order_id}/confirm-delivery/ before the order is delivered -> Receive 400 Cannot confirm
GET /api/v1/orders/{order_id}/ for a non-participant -> Receive 404 Not found

features.name: Reviews
features.description: Clients and vendors can leave one review each on completed orders, updating vendor rating aggregates when applicable.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/orders/{order_id}/confirm-delivery/ -> Receive 200 Order completed -> POST /api/v1/reviews/ with order, rating, and comment -> Receive 201 Review -> GET /api/v1/reviews/?order={order_id} -> Receive 200 Review[]
GET /api/v1/reviews/?vendor={vendor_id} -> Receive 200 reviews filtered by vendor
POST /api/v1/reviews/ for an order that is not completed -> Receive 400 Validation error (duplicate/order not complete)
POST /api/v1/reviews/ twice by the same reviewer for the same order -> Receive 400 Validation error (duplicate/order not complete)

features.name: Notifications
features.description: Users can view in-app notifications and mark them read individually or in bulk.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/notifications/ with Bearer token -> Receive 200 Notification[] -> POST /api/v1/notifications/{notification_id}/read/ -> Receive 200 Notification marked read -> POST /api/v1/notifications/read-all/ -> Receive 200 OK
GET /api/v1/notifications/ with ?unread=true -> Receive 200 unread notifications only
POST /api/v1/notifications/{notification_id}/read/ for a missing notification -> Receive 404 Not found

features.name: Messaging
features.description: Clients and vendors can open per-request conversations and exchange messages for negotiation.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/conversations/ with design_request and vendor -> Receive 201 Conversation -> POST /api/v1/conversations/{conversation_id}/messages/ with body -> Receive 201 Message -> GET /api/v1/conversations/{conversation_id}/messages/ -> Receive 200 Message[]
GET /api/v1/conversations/ -> Receive 200 list of the user's conversations
POST /api/v1/conversations/ with an invalid design_request or vendor pairing -> Receive an error response
POST /api/v1/conversations/{conversation_id}/messages/ by a non-participant -> Receive an authorization failure response

features.name: Disputes
features.description: Order participants can raise disputes, and admins can resolve or reject them.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/disputes/ with order, reason, and description -> Receive 201 Dispute -> GET /api/v1/disputes/ -> Receive 200 own dispute list or admin-wide dispute list
PATCH /api/v1/disputes/{dispute_id}/ with status=resolved and resolution by admin -> Receive 200 Dispute -> Order returns to active
PATCH /api/v1/disputes/{dispute_id}/ by a non-admin -> Receive 403 Not admin
POST /api/v1/disputes/ for an invalid or unauthorized order -> Receive 400 Validation error

features.name: Analytics
features.description: Admins can view marketplace-wide aggregate metrics in a read-only analytics overview.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/analytics/overview/ as admin -> Receive 200 { metrics } with marketplace totals and breakdowns
GET /api/v1/analytics/overview/ as a non-admin -> Receive 403 Not admin

known_limitations.issue: All non-auth endpoints require a valid internal JWT obtained via Google OAuth, which needs a real Google token; automated testing without a seeded token/user will receive 401 on protected routes.
known_limitations.impact: Protected endpoints cannot be exercised end-to-end without valid authentication credentials.
